input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 already meets or exceeds our preferred position: 11.1 gives up to six months of transition assistance on Customer's request (at expiring Order Form rates, which is better for us than then-current rates); 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding for fee disputes; and 11.3 requires secure deletion only after Customer confirms successful return, with written officer certification. Sections 10.1 and 15.1 are consistent (access ends only after the agreed transition period; Customer Data rights continue), and no suspension or payment-condition right undercuts the data return. No redline needed.
